The Growth team signs off on notifier copy changes, and any Growth engineer can approve. Post the change in **#growth-eng**.

This comes from a project memory dated 2026-09-01. The notifier moved to Growth that day when Dana Okafor moved to Platform, so an older note naming Dana as owner is out of date. I couldn't check it against the repo. There's no CODEOWNERS file, and `services/notifier/templates/` didn't turn up here. If your branch enforces reviewers some other way, that setting would take precedence.

When you edit the wording, change both files for the receipt email. Templates are `<event>.mjml` with a plain-text twin `<event>.txt` that uses the same variables, because some corporate mail gateways strip HTML. Variables are snake_case.
